turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi, how are things with you?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I can't decide what to make for dinner on Saturday when my in-laws come over.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Let me get every option on the table before you react, and I'll say when that's the last one.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: The first idea is a big roast chicken with potatoes and carrots, all in one tray in the oven.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Then there's homemade lasagna, which I could make the night before and just bake when they arrive.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: And the last one is grilled salmon with a lemon sauce and a green salad, lighter but more last minute.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: That's everything on my list. What would you go for?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Do your in-laws have any favorite foods, or anything they don't eat? If not, I'd go with the lasagna so you're not stuck in the kitchen. The roast chicken would be my second pick, it's simple and everyone likes it.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Did you put your school shoes by the door, Omar?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I'm sixty-eight and my doctor said I should do more exercise. I'm not really a gym person.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: You don't need a gym. Brisk walking, swimming or a gentle yoga class are all excellent choices.
